title: Staining the endoplasmic reticulum in combination with antibody staining.
protocol: Seed PNT2 cells on sterile coverslips for 24-48 hours.
Fix cells in 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS pH 7.4 for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells three times with PBS for five minutes each at room temperature.
Incubate samples with 0.5% w/v saponin in PBS for 15-25 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells three times with PBS for five minutes each at room temperature.
Incubate cells with 1% BSA, in PBST for 30 min at room temperature to block non-specific binding of the antibodies.
Prepare primary antibody rabbit anti-Cytochrome-C in 1% BSA in PBST at a concentration of 1 μg/ml.
Incubate cells in the diluted primary antibody for one hour at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Remove primary antibody.
Wash cells three times in PBS for five minutes each.
Prepare secondary antibody at a concentration of 1/1000 dilution in 1% BSA in PBST.
Incubate cells with the secondary antibody for one hour at room temperature in the dark.
Aspirate the secondary antibody.
Wash cells three times with PBS for five minutes each.
Prepare 10 mM stock solutions of ReZolve-ER by dissolving powder in DMSO as instructed on the vial.
Dilute the stock solution in PBS to a final concentration of 20 μM (1/500 dilution).
Incubate cells with staining solution for 30 min at room temperature, in the dark.
Remove coverslips from the staining solution and mount in aqueous mounting media.
Adhere coverslips to the slide using quick-dry nail polish.
Image samples by confocal microscopy for best results.
Use a UV, 385 nm or 400 nm light source for excitation of ReZolve-ER.
Detect ReZolve-ER with a detector compatible with FITC or tuneable detector set to a detection range of 525 nm - 600 nm.
Set imaging parameters appropriate for the selected secondary antibody, such as using a 647 nm excitation and a far-red fluorophore-compatible detector.
Perform sequential imaging to avoid signal bleed through.
